## 1. CLASSES AND DISPOSITIONS (the closed vocabularies)

- **CHARTER-GAP** -- a gap in the round-2 charter's scope, raised pre-charter (Andrew-supplied CRO~X review)
- **CONTRACT** -- a defect in ISCK_CONTRACT.md / the schema / the validator at a cited tip
- **DESIGN-INPUT** -- a defect or required input against the R2-2 design draft (attacked-dry, landing carried)
- **BATTERY** -- a defect in the gate suite / probes / runner (R2-9)
- **RECORD** -- a false or unauditable claim in a governed record (boundary record, disposition, commit message)
- **PROCESS** -- a defect in how the round was run (tree atomicity, lane gates, write halves)
- **VERIFIER-SELF** -- a verifier's own false verdict, self-corrected on the record

- **ADOPTED-INTO-CHARTER** -- became a charter workstream
- **FIXED** -- artifact changed at fix_commit; verification_ref names the second seat's read
- **FIXED-IN-DESIGN** -- R2-2 design draft amended; the schema change itself is carried to the R2-2 landing
- **RESOLVED-BY-DESIGN-CARRIED** -- resolved by the R2-2 design; lands with the R2-2 landing checklist line named in disposition_basis
- **AMENDED-RECORD** -- the governed record was amended (first-printed value kept beside the measured one)
- **DISCLOSED-NO-CHANGE** -- disclosed on the record; no artifact change was the right remedy
- **SELF-REFUTED** -- the attacker refuted its own claim before or at filing (re-run through the full instrument)
- **SELF-CORRECTED** -- a verifier retracted its own verdict on the record
- **RESOLVED-BY-THIS-REGISTER** -- the finding asked for exactly this artifact
